capture_source: native capture-car batch, first factory paint
parts_price_source: US 05F5E0 and 060308, transcribed in QuestPartsSession; original class, gear and tire/wheel dimensions from CarInfo
dealer_price_source: Original normal-car prices: CarInfo signed halfword at 0x310 times ten. Port traffic prices: CarCatalog::GetDealerPrice overrides. Class T and challenge unlocking are port additions.
parts_price_scope: Normal cars 000-131 use source-derived prices; Class T models 132-139 use port shop rules and the delivery-lorry tire-size override. Prices do not by themselves establish stock or compatibility.
parts_stock_source: BuildQuestPartsStock initial counts, source priority thresholds and persistent unlock bits; QuestPartsSession compatibility flags; WithTrafficFinalStage port override and GetPrice availability.
notes: Car ID is zero-based CARMODEL record index; type code is from the record.
Capture batch previously generated; per-vehicle original comparisons remain outstanding.
Models 136 and 138 use labeled native model-viewer screenshots; standard capture framing still needs correction. Model 138 is shown from the rear.

The port makes all eight traffic models playable in Class T after their respective challenges. Model 136 uses model 139 tire sizes for shop prices; its 19-inch wheel diameter is outside the ordinary wheel-price table.
part_effect_source: Port RaceCarTuning::Configure and PhysicalCoefficients; original CarInfo, one fitted variant against all-Normal neutral baseline; front/rear grip are initial actor coefficients and aerodynamic values are source coefficient deltas, not fixed force percentages
part_peak_power_source: Port RaceCarTuning::Configure, signed peak HP field 0x34; stock and single-part neutral configurations
additional_part_effect_source: Port RaceCarTuning::Configure, RaceContactDynamics and RaceVehiclePrelude: length, width, air resistance, spring, damping, brake, rolling-resistance and offset-labelled coefficient deltas; single-part neutral baseline
quest_availability_source: QuestRivalProgress::ApplyBattleResult, QuestProgress::PatchQuestRestartRivals, QuestProgressData initial set and unlock rules, and CarCatalog::GetQuestRosters; mapping from source SessionRivals car IDs.
